bagPolicy.summary: GIANT Center does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at GIANT Center can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in GIANT Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The GIANT Center offers a wide variety of food and beverage options, including traditional concessions like hot dogs and nachos, as well as unique offerings such as Cuban sandwiches and smoked barbecue. Beverage options include a selection of beers, cocktails, and fresh squeezed lemonades.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you have specific accessibility questions or concerns, please contact Box Office Customer Service directly at 717-534-3300, TTY 717-534-8955. Accessible parking is located in the Preferred Parking Lot and in the General Parking areas.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in GIANT Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at Hersheypark Stadium Box Office and opens at 9 a.m. on the day of the concert. GIANT Center's team will be happy to assist you with your specific requests during regular box office hours.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at GIANT Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
